addons.name: British English Dictionary (Marco Pinto)
addons.description:
A fork of Mark Tyndall's add-on, based on David Bartlett's
British Dictionary R1.19 for Firefox, Thunderbird and SeaMonkey.
addons.fullDescription:
British English Dictionary V4
For Firefox, Thunderbird, and SeaMonkey
A carefully maintained, community-driven resource for accurate British English spelling.



📢 Update

As of March 2025, this dictionary fully aligns with modern -ise verb spellings (e.g., “organise”).
For specific -ise/-ize variants, some verbs and words MAY be missing or included differently.



🔗 Websites

    https://proofingtoolgui.org (Proofing Tool GUI)
    https://github.com/marcoagpinto/aoo-mozilla-en-dict (GitHub)
    https://linkedin.com/in/marcoagpinto (LinkedIn)
    https://addons.mozilla.org/addon/british-english-dictionary-2 (Firefox add-on)
    https://addons.thunderbird.net/addon/british-english-dictionary-2 (Thunderbird add-on)
    https://extensions.libreoffice.org/extensions/english-dictionaries (LibreOffice extension) 




🌟 Key Features

    150 000+ words added since 2013 (updated to V4)
    Based primarily on Oxford and Collins dictionaries
    Covers both modern and literary vocabulary
    Compatible with Commonwealth/European English variants 




🔍 Inclusion Rules

    Words must appear in at least two authoritative sources (e.g., Oxford + Collins) (except proper nouns)
    Archaic terms included only if they do not conflict with modern usage
    U.S. spellings are retained when widely adopted in British English (e.g., “movie”) and validated by trusted sources
        Note: The dictionary's U.S. origins explain why many U.S. words are present.




📥 Installation

    Firefox/Thunderbird 115+ (ESR): Install directly from Mozilla Add-ons
    Legacy Firefox/Thunderbird (v59 or earlier):
        Download the .xpi file from GitHub: https://github.com/marcoagpinto/aoo-mozilla-en-dict
        Drag & drop the downloaded .xpi file into the Extensions/Dictionaries window
    Enable via right-click in an editable text area: “Languages” → “English (United Kingdom)”


📚 Full guide: https://proofingtoolgui.org/en_installing.html



🛠 Developer Commitment

    15+ years of continuous updates
    Personally funded (hosting, Oxford Premium access, domains)
    Open-source collaboration on GitHub
    Built on the Proofing Tool GUI framework for transparent validation 




❓ FAQ Highlights

    Why include “movie”? → FAQ #7
    How to report issues → FAQ #4
    View full changelog → https://proofingtoolgui.org/en_GB_CHANGES.txt 




🤝 Community-Driven

This project advances thanks to your input:
- Found a missing Oxford/Collins word? → Submit via e-mail or GitHub
- Found a U.S. spelling that should be removed? → Provide dictionary citations
- Having technical issues? → Report via e-mail or GitHub



ℹ Ethical Notes

    No AI or automated scraping – all entries are manually verified
    Archaic terms included cautiously for literary users
    Hosting costs covered privately 


This dictionary serves students, professionals, writers, and non-native speakers alike.
Your feedback helps ensure it remains the most reliable free British English resource available.

addons.name: uBlock Origin
addons.description: Finally, an efficient wide-spectrum content blocker. Easy on CPU and memory.
addons.fullDescription:
uBlock Origin is not an "ad blocker", it's a wide-spectrum content blocker with CPU and memory efficiency as a primary feature. Out of the box, uBO blocks ads, trackers, coin miners, popups, etc. through the following lists of filters, enabled by default: EasyList (ads) EasyPrivacy (tracking) Peter Lowe’s Ad server list (ads and tracking) Online Malicious URL Blocklist uBO's own lists More lists are available for you to select if you wish: EasyList Cookie Fanboy Annoyances AdGuard Annoyances Dan Pollock’s hosts file And many others Additionally, you can point-and-click to block JavaScript locally or globally, create your own global or local rules to override entries from filter lists, and many more advanced features. Free. Open source with public license (GPLv3) For users by users. If ever you really do want to contribute something, think about the people working hard to maintain the filter lists you are using, which were made available to use by all for free.

  • Contributors @ GitHub
  • Contributors @ Crowdin

addons.name: NoScript Security Suite
addons.description: The best security you can get in a web browser! Allow potentially malicious web content to run only from sites you trust. Protect yourself against XSS other web security exploits.
addons.fullDescription:
Winner of the "PC World - World Class Award" and bundled with the Tor Browser, NoScript gives you the best available protection on the web. It allows JavaScript, Flash, and other executable content to run only from trusted domains of your choice (e.g. your banking site), thus mitigating remotely exploitable vulnerabilities, such as Spectre and Meltdown.

It protects your "trust boundaries" against cross-site scripting attacks (XSS), cross-zone DNS rebinding / CSRF attacks (router hacking), and Clickjacking attempts, thanks to its unique ClearClick technology.

Such a preemptive approach prevents exploitation of security vulnerabilities (known and unknown!) with no loss of functionality where you need it.
Experts do agree: Firefox is really safer with NoScript!

FAQ: https://noscript.net/faq
Forum: https://noscript.net/forum

A Basic NoScript 10 Guide

Still confused by NoScript 10's new UI?
Check this user-contributed NoScript 10 primer.
and this NoScript 10 "Quantum" vs NoScript 5 "Classic" (or "Legacy") comparison.

screenshots.caption: You are finally in control, and can decide by yourself which sites you TRUST. Don't let any unknown or UNTRUSTED sites to execute scripts and use other potentially dangerous capabilities in your browser!

You can globally configure permissions for all the websites (DEFAULT preset), those you trust (TRUSTED) and those which you don't trust (UNTRUSTED). Then you can CUSTOMize them further for each site, if you want.
Both dark and light color schemes are supported!
